title: Stored XSS Detection via Form Input Submission: Snippets, Color, and HTML Attributes
goal: Gruyere has multiple stored XSS vulnerabilities that require an authenticated session AND form submission to detect: (1) Snippet stored XSS — POST /newsnippet with snippet=<a onmouseover=alert(1)> causes XSS when anyone views the profile; (2) Color attribute injection — POST /saveprofile with color=red' onload=alert(1) injects event handler into style attribute; (3) AJAX JSON injection — stored snippet with special characters breaks JSON response from /feed.gtl. The auth-flow runner currently tests login but does not submit application-specific forms. Extend auth-flow (or create a new stored-xss-probe runner) to: (a) after authenticating, submit XSS payloads to ALL discovered POST forms (from web-crawler backlog-343); (b) retrieve the page that renders the stored content (profile/home/feed); (c) check if the payload appears unescaped (as executable HTML, not HTML-entity-encoded); (d) report stored XSS with the form, parameter, and rendering page.
generation_reason: Stored XSS via /newsnippet (snippet parameter) and /saveprofile (color parameter) cannot be detected without authenticating and submitting forms. No current runner does this for generic web apps.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.canary_payloads_only: Use canary payloads (unique random strings embedded in tags) that do NOT execute in the scanner's own browser context. Check for presence in HTML source, not runtime execution.
constraints.scope_enforcement: Only submit to forms within approved scope.
constraints.cleanup: After testing, attempt to clean up stored canary content (delete snippet, reset profile) if delete/edit endpoints are available.
constraints.session_required: This runner requires a valid test session. Use credentials from run_credential_vault or test accounts. Skip if no credentials available.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.canary_pattern: Generate unique canary: 'aegispt-xss-{uuid4().hex[:8]}'. Embed in payloads: , . Check if canary appears in response HTML without encoding.
implementation_notes.form_submission_flow: 1. Authenticate. 2. GET form URL to get hidden fields (CSRF tokens if any). 3. POST form with canary payload. 4. GET rendering URL. 5. Check for canary in unencoded form.
implementation_notes.attribute_injection: For style/class attributes: test payloads like 'red' onmouseover='alert(1)' and 'expression(alert(1))'. Check if the attribute value contains the unescaped quote and event handler.
implementation_notes.ajax_endpoint_test: For JSON/AJAX endpoints: check if stored content appears in JSON responses without proper JSON escaping (raw quotes, newlines).

acceptance_criteria: Runner detects stored XSS in Gruyere's snippet form (/newsnippet) and reports finding with type='stored_xss_form_input'.
Runner detects attribute injection in /saveprofile color field and reports type='stored_xss_attribute_injection'.
Canary cleanup attempted after each test.
No runtime script execution occurs in the scanner — detection is source-code based.
